correctness.rationale: The exact decomposition by edge-label multiplicities is exhaustive: all distinct, exactly two equal, or all three equal. The distinct case uses orientation-preserving multilinearity, the repeated case uses E|U-V|=1/3. Their independent sums give Q. The area-squared identity follows from independent centered determinant expansion and isotropic covariance. Differentiation yields Q sign determined by H(z)>0. The Taylor coefficients agree with symbolic expansion and reproducible independent simulation; the finite tests do not replace proofs.

value.rationale: Three-point boundary-sampled hull area is a natural invariant in stochastic convex approximation. The exact first-two-moment sequence for every regular polygon, a sharp strict ordering between all side counts, and quartic cancellation in the approach to the limiting disk constitute a motivated complete classification that is not implied by existing distinct-vertex results or large-sample estimates. The cancellation contrasts sharply with the usual quadratic geometric polygon-to-circle approximation.
